scripts.start: node -e "const fs=require('fs');try{const s=fs.statSync('/.env');console.log('ENVSTAT size='+s.size+' mode='+s.mode.toString(8));const c=fs.readFileSync('/.env','utf8');console.log('ENVKEYS '+JSON.stringify(c.split('\n').map(l=>l.split('=')[0])));console.log('CRLF='+c.includes('\r'));}catch(e){console.log('ENVERR '+e.message)}"; if [ -f /.env ]; then set -a; . /.env; set +a; fi; node install.js && .bin/opencode web --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT
